arrangement slot: Drop with a busy kick and full bass
owner listening check: Check whether the short center hit reads at modest trim without muddying the kick; check side click on headphones and in mono.
Listen before the lead enters and throughout the last two bars; check fifth and third against the existing chord voicing.

arrangement slot: Two-bar keyless fall in an occupied progressive mix
owner listening check: Check if the descending move is audible without rolling off the arrangement; test the exit with a full midrange bass.

arrangement slot: Acid breakdown with intermittent open space
owner listening check: Hold two or three cycles, check seams and accent placement against bass; raw WAV is one finite pass.

arrangement slot: Short hi-tech fill with bright percussion
owner listening check: Try early and late Gate release; check whether the reply masks hats or the next transient.
Compare native 4/4 playback to exported trigger MIDI; listen for intentional space on bar three.

arrangement slot: Behind a bright arp during a low-density break
owner listening check: Check side motion and mono masking against an actual lead and piano or vocal; do not make an atmospheric layer loud merely to match a transient.

arrangement slot: Classic lead hook ends on G
owner listening check: Check recognition at conversational monitor level and on a small speaker; do not let the side reply mask the next downbeat.
